title: Turn repeated work into governed procedures
supabiz_proposal: Suggest saving stable steps with variable inputs, business scope, owner, output contract and last verified run.
measure: Procedure reuse; duplicated setup; verified outcomes

title: Move predictable steps into code
supabiz_proposal: Use tested arithmetic, normalization, dedupe and exact lookups where applicable; retain uncertain interpretation as model work.
measure: Cost and error rate by step

title: Keep an explicit exception path
supabiz_proposal: Guard applicability and source quality; escalate unfamiliar or contradictory cases rather than forcing a cheap answer.
measure: Missed exceptions; false fallback; resolution time

title: Separate learning from live execution
supabiz_proposal: Collect traces, propose changes and evaluate offline; publish versioned releases with canary and rollback.

title: Distinguish memory, prompts, routing and training
supabiz_proposal: Label what changed. A saved correction or workflow does not imply model-weight training.

title: Package purpose, evidence, tools and output together
supabiz_proposal: Give each responsibility an inspectable contract and sample case; expose business language before advanced configuration.

title: Make draft, tested and active separate states
supabiz_proposal: Require evaluation and authorized publication before production behavior changes; SDK build success alone is insufficient.

title: Persist run identity across devices and restarts
supabiz_proposal: Save input refs, procedure version, submission identity and progress before dispatch; reconnect to existing work.

title: Make batches visible per business record
supabiz_proposal: Show individual completed, pending, exception and failed records; retry selected unresolved rows.
measure: Partial failures hidden; duplicate successful rows

title: Expose first-run and pause semantics
supabiz_proposal: Show whether enabling starts immediately, timezone and next run; acknowledge in-flight work when pausing.
measure: Unexpected runs; missed schedules; pause comprehension

title: Enforce cumulative budgets
supabiz_proposal: Combine per-run, per-batch, recurring and monthly/business reservations with concurrency fairness.

title: Review exact multi-stage plans
supabiz_proposal: Bind plan approval to version/digest while separately authorizing each material external effect.

title: Validate outputs beyond JSON shape
supabiz_proposal: Check schema, domain arithmetic, source evidence and current records before posting or assigning.

title: Keep transport retry separate from business retry
supabiz_proposal: Use durable request identity, same-body idempotency where supported and outcome reconciliation before repeat effects.

title: Pin clients and verify deployment contracts
supabiz_proposal: Test exact SDK/package versions against actual deployment capability and status contracts; resolve doc/source drift.

title: Retain raw and normalized statuses
supabiz_proposal: Show useful business states but retain provider state for diagnosis; unknown states need explicit handling.

title: Prove improvements at equal outcome quality
supabiz_proposal: Freeze normal/exception cohorts; compare full cost, accuracy, human minutes and tail latency without future leakage.

title: Keep traces, procedures and sharing permission-aware
supabiz_proposal: Apply business/matter/audience policy to evidence, logs and derived procedures; private reports by default.

title: Preserve action controls after optimization
supabiz_proposal: Generated code and stronger models use the same credential broker, grants and exact approval checks.

title: Offer a readable improvement comparison
supabiz_proposal: Show changed steps, evidence, measured sample and costs; distinguish proposed, tested and released improvements.
measure: Misleading savings claims; adoption and rollback comprehension
